about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The CimcimKids story
about.p1: CimcimKids was founded to offer clothing kids can move freely in and parents can trust. Our mission is to bring together comfort, quality, and simple style.
about.p2: Our collections span from baby to school age. Every piece is carefully chosen with fabrics suited to everyday life and play.
about.p3: Comfort, durability, and customer satisfaction are our core values. Let’s complete little wardrobes together.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your questions
faq.q1: How should I choose a size?
faq.a1: Each product page includes age/size guidance. If unsure, size up or contact us.
faq.a2: Domestic orders are delivered within 2–5 business days. Track your order on our tracking page.
faq.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: We accept bank transfer (wire/EFT). After placing your order, IBAN details are shown and the order is emailed to us.
faq.q4: How should I wash the products?
faq.a4: Most of our products are suitable for a gentle 30°C wash. Please follow the care label on each item.
faq.a5: Yes, just note 'gift wrap' in your order. We offer complimentary gift wrapping.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security Policy
privacy.intro: At CimcimKids, we take the security of your personal data seriously.
privacy.s1: Collected data is used only for order processing, account management, customer service, and legal obligations. Details are set out in the KVKK Privacy Notice.
privacy.s2: Payment details are used only for bank transfers; we do not store card data. Our website and database run on Hetzner infrastructure in Germany / the EU (and, where needed, cloud database providers in the EU/EEA), so your data may be processed abroad for hosting purposes.
privacy.s3: Cookies and similar technologies are used to improve site experience and manage sessions; you can control them in browser settings. If you sign in with Google, Google’s own privacy policy also applies.

distanceSales.title: Distance Sales Agreement
distanceSales.s1: This agreement is concluded between seller Nuriye Kostak (CimcimKids, sole proprietorship) and the consumer under applicable consumer protection laws.
distanceSales.s2: Order confirmation is sent by email. Right of withdrawal can be exercised within 14 days.
distanceSales.s3: Product prices include VAT. Payment is made via bank transfer; shipping is free.

kvkk.title: Personal Data Protection Notice (KVKK)
kvkk.intro: Under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), we inform you about how CimcimKids processes your personal data.
kvkk.s1: Data controller: Nuriye Kostak (CimcimKids, sole proprietorship). Didim Tax Office, TIN 1630080944. Address: Akbük Mah. 5932 Cad. Rüyamkent Sitesi No: 7/4 Didim / Aydın. Contact: efruzebendes@hotmail.com — Phone: 0541 358 84 57
kvkk.s2: Identity data (name, surname), contact data (email, phone, address), order and transaction data (products, amount, order number), account and session data, customer transaction history; and, if you opt in, newsletter subscription data.
kvkk.s3: Receiving and delivering orders, managing payment processes (bank transfer), membership and account management, customer service and communication, securely operating site infrastructure, fulfilling legal obligations, performance of the distance sales agreement; and, with explicit consent, marketing / newsletter communication.
kvkk.s4title: 4. Transfer of Personal Data and Cross-Border Transfer
kvkk.s4: Your personal data may be transferred to authorized public institutions when legally required, to shipping companies for delivery, and to technical infrastructure providers we use. Our website and database are hosted on servers of Hetzner Online GmbH in Germany / the European Union (and, where needed, cloud database providers in the EU/EEA). Due to this hosting, your personal data is transferred abroad under KVKK Art. 9. Purpose of the transfer: secure website hosting and storage/processing of order and customer data. If you choose Google sign-in, limited data may also be transferred to Google abroad for authentication. Cross-border transfers are carried out with the data subject’s information and explicit consent given at checkout/registration and, to the extent necessary for contract performance, under other applicable KVKK grounds.
kvkk.s5: Your data is collected electronically via the website order form, contact form, account registration / sign-in, newsletter signup, and automated log / security records. Legal bases: KVKK Art. 5/2-c (establishment or performance of a contract), Art. 5/2-ç (legal obligation), Art. 5/2-f (legitimate interest); and for cross-border transfer and marketing communications, explicit consent under KVKK Art. 5/1 and Art. 9.
kvkk.s6: Your personal data is retained for the period required by the processing purpose and applicable legal retention periods (10 years for commercial records), then deleted, destroyed, or anonymized.
kvkk.s7: Under KVKK Art. 11, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, request information, learn the purpose and whether it is used accordingly, know third parties in Turkey or abroad to whom data is transferred, request correction, request deletion or destruction, and withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
kvkk.s8: To exercise your rights, send a written request to efruzebendes@hotmail.com. Your requests will be answered free of charge within 30 days at the latest.
